sample1_text: Sent the proposal over yesterday. Not sure they will go for it, the timeline is tight and the budget is a stretch for what we discussed. Will chase Sarah on Monday if I have not heard back. Pls remember we still need sign off from legal before anything moves. Also worth flagging the Manchester office wants their own version of this, different numbers entirely.
sample2_completions: This isn't what we briefed, not close, I need it redone properly not patched, let's talk before you touch it again.
I build things and try not to run out of money doing it, that's most of the job honestly.
I've decided we're not doing the Manchester version separately, one build, one set of numbers, I'll tell them myself.
When someone agrees to something then quietly does the opposite, that's the one thing I can't get past.
